Smart Reads of the Week: Singapore Dividend Stocks, Retirement REITs, and Long-Term Investing Ideas
article:
The best investments are often the ones you can own for years, not months. Businesses with durable competitive advantages, growing cash flows, and a commitment to rewarding shareholders have the potential to compound wealth through both rising share prices and increasing dividends.
This week’s Smart Reads focuses on companies and REITs that fit that description. From core dividend stocks and retirement income ideas to overlooked value plays and businesses built to stand the test of time, these articles explore what it takes to build a resilient portfolio for the years ahead.
Here are this week’s top articles:
5 Core Singapore Dividend Stocks to Buy and Hold
These five established businesses have the qualities that long-term dividend investors look for.
Is Sembcorp or Keppel a Better Long-Term Investment for Infrastructure?
We compare two infrastructure leaders to see which offers the stronger long-term investment case.
5 Singapore REITs for Reliable Retirement Income
These REITs could provide investors with dependable distributions for years to come.
Sheng Siong Shares Look Expensive: Are They Still a Buy?
Despite trading near record highs, does this supermarket operator still deserve a place on your watchlist?
Beyond STI: 3 REITs Declaring Their Latest DPU This Week
A closer look at three REITs rewarding investors with fresh distributions and what to watch in their latest results.
Keppel Corporation: Why Analysts Are Overlooking Its Deep Value
We examine why Keppel may still offer attractive value despite its strong share price performance.
Venture Shares Offer a Tempting 5% Yield: Is the Dividend Safe?
We assess whether Venture’s generous dividend is backed by a resilient business.
Why Income Investors Look at Long-Term Blue Chips for Kids
Discover why quality blue-chip companies can make powerful long-term investments for the next generation.
